speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are presenting with persistent bleeding after a wisdom tooth extraction and a history of easy bruising; we need to determine if this indicates an underlying bleeding disorder. To start, can you describe the amount and duration of the bleeding since the extraction?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information; the family history of joint swelling and bleeding in your uncle strongly suggests an X-linked bleeding disorder. Given your age and the lack of response to gauze, did you experience any spontaneous bleeding from other sites, such as your nose or gums, before the extraction?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Persistent bleeding from gums following tooth extraction. I also have History of easy bruising, Family history of similar bleeding problems and joint swelling.
